description: T20 TiDB 8.5 placement-policy oracles. The manifest pins the metadata-backed binding warning path (ddl.tidb.placement.warn), the proven policy-existence premise (8239 missing-policy refusal, 8241 bound-drop refusal), the DEFAULT unbind at table/schema/partition/range scope, ALTER RANGE's bounded name set (global|meta land, others refuse 1105), and the MySQL vendor boundary. Catalog binding evidence is distinct from topology deployment: SHOW PLACEMENT PENDING never counts as placement proof. Native observations and internal projections are separate evidence layers; this manifest is not a passing-result claim.
